messages.author: Pekka Pylväs
messages.text: Mikko, TRN-015 Kittilä. Swapped the SFP, link is up, no alarms, but no traffic. Erkki is on holiday, any ideas?

messages.author: Mikko Mäkelä
messages.text: Just reboot the unit, that usually sorts it out

messages.author: Pekka Pylväs
messages.text: The whole node? That takes everything down

messages.author: Mikko Mäkelä
messages.text: Yeah takes maybe 20 min but it resets everything

messages.author: Pekka Pylväs
messages.text: Back up after 20 min. Counters still zero on that port 😩 and NOC is asking why the whole site dropped

messages.author: Mikko Mäkelä
messages.text: Hmm, so that didn't help. No idea then, sorry. Maybe wait for Erkki
